name: mapbox_geocode
description: Forward geocode an address to coordinates using Mapbox. Returns results with relevance scores.

proximity.description: lng,lat to bias results near a location

name: mapbox_reverse_geocode
description: Reverse geocode coordinates to an address using Mapbox.

types.description: Filter by place type: address, poi, neighborhood, etc.

name: mapbox_batch_geocode
description: Geocode multiple addresses in one call. Returns coordinates and found/not-found status for each.

name: mapbox_geocode_address_only
description: Forward geocode filtered to address results only — excludes POIs, cities, and regions.

name: mapbox_search_places
description: Search for places or POIs by name/category, optionally near given coordinates.

name: mapbox_validate_address
description: Validate an address using Mapbox geocoding — returns whether it's valid, normalized form, and confidence score.

name: mapbox_address_to_coordinates
description: Simplified geocoding — returns just longitude and latitude for an address.

name: mapbox_coordinates_to_address
description: Simplified reverse geocoding — returns just the address string for coordinates.

name: mapbox_get_directions
description: Get driving (or other profile) directions between waypoints including distance, duration, and geometry.

name: mapbox_get_walking_directions
description: Get walking directions between waypoints including distance and turn-by-turn steps.

name: mapbox_get_cycling_directions
description: Get cycling directions between waypoints.

name: mapbox_get_turn_by_turn
description: Get detailed turn-by-turn navigation instructions for a route.

name: mapbox_optimize_route
description: Solve the Traveling Salesman Problem — find the optimal order for multiple stops to minimize total travel time.

name: mapbox_get_map_matching
description: Snap a GPS trace to the road network — corrects noisy GPS coordinates to actual roads.

radiuses.description: Search radius in meters for each coordinate

name: mapbox_get_matrix
description: Get a travel time/distance matrix between multiple origins and destinations in one API call.

name: mapbox_get_isochrone
description: Generate isochrone polygons showing the reachable area within a given time or distance from a point.

minutes.description: Number or array of drive-time minutes

meters.description: Number or array of distance meters (alternative to minutes)

name: mapbox_get_service_area
description: Generate concentric service area polygons (15/30/60 min drive radii) from a location — key for YardSync coverage zones.

name: mapbox_get_static_map_url
description: Generate a static map image URL with optional pin markers.

name: mapbox_get_satellite_map_url
description: Generate a satellite imagery map URL for given coordinates.

name: mapbox_get_route_map_url
description: Generate a static map image URL showing a start and end pin for a route.

name: mapbox_calculate_distance
description: Calculate straight-line (as-the-crow-flies) distance between two coordinates in miles and km (no API call).

name: mapbox_calculate_bearing
description: Calculate the compass bearing (direction) from one coordinate to another.

name: mapbox_calculate_midpoint
description: Find the geographic midpoint between two coordinates.

name: mapbox_point_in_polygon
description: Check if a coordinate point is inside a GeoJSON polygon (ray-casting, no API call).

polygon.description: GeoJSON polygon geometry or coordinates array

name: mapbox_list_datasets
description: List all Mapbox datasets in the account (requires MAPBOX_USERNAME env var).

name: mapbox_create_dataset
description: Create a new Mapbox dataset for storing GeoJSON features.

name: mapbox_get_dataset
description: Get metadata for a specific Mapbox dataset.

name: mapbox_delete_dataset
description: Delete a Mapbox dataset.

name: mapbox_list_dataset_features
description: List GeoJSON features in a Mapbox dataset.

name: mapbox_add_dataset_feature
description: Add or update a GeoJSON feature in a Mapbox dataset.

name: mapbox_delete_dataset_feature
description: Delete a specific feature from a Mapbox dataset.

name: mapbox_list_tilesets
description: List tilesets in the Mapbox account.

name: mapbox_get_tileset
description: Get metadata for a specific Mapbox tileset.

name: mapbox_delete_tileset
description: Delete a Mapbox tileset.

name: mapbox_list_styles
description: List all custom map styles in the Mapbox account.

name: mapbox_get_style
description: Get a custom map style definition by its ID.

name: mapbox_delete_style
description: Delete a custom map style.

name: mapbox_list_uploads
description: List pending and recent uploads to Mapbox.

name: mapbox_get_upload
description: Get the status and details of a Mapbox upload.

name: mapbox_delete_upload
description: Delete a Mapbox upload.

name: mapbox_find_nearest_depot
description: SUPER TOOL: Geocode a customer address and find the nearest depot from a list — returns distance to each, sorted closest first.

depots.description: Array of depot objects with address field or address strings

name: mapbox_check_service_coverage
description: SUPER TOOL: Check if an address falls inside a service area polygon (geofence) — returns true/false with normalized address.

service_area_polygon.description: GeoJSON polygon geometry or coordinates array defining the service boundary

name: mapbox_batch_eta
description: SUPER TOOL: Get ETAs and driving distances from one depot to many addresses using the matrix API — ideal for scheduling.

name: mapbox_plan_driver_stops
description: SUPER TOOL: Geocode all stop addresses and return an optimized stop order with total distance and drive time — complete daily route planning.

name: mapbox_service_area_map
description: SUPER TOOL: Geocode a depot address and generate concentric drive-time isochrone polygons plus a static map URL — service coverage visualization in one call.
